punchline: The book that says EQ explains 58% of job success comes from the founders of the company that sells the EQ test.
thirty_sec: Bradberry and Greaves founded TalentSmart, which tests emotional intelligence, and their book says EQ explains 58% of job performance and that 90% of top performers are high in it. That is the company's own data, not independent research. The idea that holds up on its own is their split: IQ and personality mostly stay put, EQ can be practiced, and they list 66 strategies under four skills.
